evals.name: account-research-eval-1-tool-mandate-icp-baseline-first
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'research Northwind Logistics for me — are they a fit?' — the conversation already contains a note describing what a good customer looks like
evals.expected_output: The skill calls ask_zime FIRST for our own ICP baseline, then runs web research on Northwind. The fit assessment is anchored to the returned ICP, not to the conversation note or a generic B2B SaaS prior.
expectations: ask_zime is called before any web search, asking about OUR ICP and won-customer patterns
The ask_zime question does NOT contain the prospect's name (Zime has no data on them)
The fit assessment cites the returned ICP rather than the earlier conversation note

evals.name: account-research-eval-2-existing-customer-routes-away
evals.prompt: user asks: 'get me up to speed on Acme before the QBR' — Acme is already a customer in CRM
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes Acme is an existing account, not a prospect, and routes to get-account (for the CRM record) rather than running the prospect-research web flow.
expectations: The skill does not run the prospect web-research flow for an existing customer

evals.name: account-research-eval-3-unanchored-icp-labels-provisional
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, ask_zime returns nothing useful about our ICP; the user asked to research Northwind Logistics
evals.expected_output: The skill still delivers the web-research brief, but states plainly the fit assessment is unanchored and labels the ICP scorecard provisional. It does not quietly substitute a generic B2B SaaS ICP.
expectations: The web-research brief is still delivered
The scorecard is explicitly labeled provisional with the reason stated
No generic ICP is silently substituted for ours

evals.name: account-research-eval-4-no-source-means-unknown
evals.prompt: user asks to research a small private company whose headcount and funding are not stated on any public source found
evals.expected_output: The scorecard records headcount and funding as unknown, with no invented figures, and every stated fact carries a source link.
expectations: Headcount and funding are reported as unknown rather than estimated
No named champion, headcount, or funding figure appears without a cited source
Cited links accompany the facts that are stated
